I confirmed these numbers minutes ago but haven't updated the rollout proposal yet.

transcript.text: I need to raise an engineering constraint before we finalize the rollout config. While debugging an unrelated queue-consumer issue this morning, I found that more than 2 concurrent inference requests can exhaust the triage worker's connection pool. When that happens, timeouts bypass the intended manual-review fallback and leave tickets without a routing label. I haven't filed this in the launch ticket yet. The fix is straightforward: capping concurrency at 2 in the rollout configuration is sufficient to satisfy this constraint, and no separate engineering deployment is required before flag enablement.
